questions.q: If your favorite place lost every good thing, what would be left?
questions.answer: Nothing worth wanting: no joy, no beauty, nothing refreshing. The lesson uses that picture to show what hell is like: life with every good gift of God taken away.

questions.q: If God is good and allows suffering, how can hell fit with that?
questions.answer: Hell isn't God enjoying punishment; it brings Him no pleasure. It's what's left when someone keeps rejecting Him, and a loving God invites us but won't force us.

questions.q: Why does it matter whether God sends people to hell or we send ourselves?
questions.answer: It shows God isn't cruel. He honors our choices, so people who keep refusing Him get what they chose. That makes His invitation right now really matter.
